name: Awata Izuna
source: A member of the idol group "Meteall". She's short in stature but her appeal lies in her energetic dance moves. She never skives off training and has a stoic disposition. She's popular because of her short and curvy figure but she's not too happy with her disproportionately large bust size. Previously, she was traumatised after being molested on a crowded train so she's not comfortable dealing with the opposite sex.
